concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑001 (≥ 95 % of problems have all three explanations) is not explicitly addressed or measured in any phase; the plan only mentions timeout handling and logging but does not state a metric or verification step for the 95 % threshold.

Success Criterion SC‑005 (≥ 99 % of simulated logs contain all required fields and response‑time distribution coverage) is not referenced; the plan logs required fields but does not include a check or report on the response‑time histogram coverage requirement.

Functional Requirement FR‑020 (simulation data must be treated as exploratory diagnostics only) is not explicitly stated; while the plan mentions exploratory diagnostics (SC‑009), it does not contain a clear rule that simulation logs must not be used for primary hypothesis testing.
